title: Benchmark Run Monitoring Screenshots Index (Latency/$ report)
content:
Purpose
- This is an index of the monitoring evidence (dashboards + screenshots + a few short screen recordings) captured during the benchmark execution windows for the public “production economics / latency per dollar” report.
- Goal is credibility + internal validation: show that (a) region health was stable, (b) GPU saturation and queuing were within expected ranges, (c) error rates were low, (d) guardrails were active, (e) cost/metering signals were consistent.

How to use
- For report review: link the “end-of-run summary” screenshots per region/model family when reviewers ask “how do we know this wasn’t an incident / noisy infra day?”
- For anomaly triage: compare “mid-run” vs “end-run” + region health panel.
- For later refreshes: keep capturing the same set so we can compare runs apples-to-apples.

Conventions
- Region codes: use Redwood region IDs shown in the report tables.
- Timestamp format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (local time) + UTC in parentheses.
- Screenshot naming: bm_<suite>_<region>_<model-family>_<phase>_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMZ>.png
  - phase is warmup | midrun | endrun | anomaly
- Storage:
  - Primary: Drive folder per run window (links below)
  - Backup: internal artifact bucket (read-only) for immutable retention

Dashboards covered (expected in every run)
1) “Benchmark Run Overview” (global)
   - p50/p95 end-to-end latency, tokens/sec, request rate, error rate, queue depth
2) “Region Health” (per region)
   - load balancer health, node readiness, GPU fleet saturation, throttles, packet loss
3) “Serving Runtime” (per region)
   - continuous batching stats, KV cache hit-rate, prefill vs decode breakdown
4) “Billing/Metering Sanity” (global + per region)
   - cost-per-1M tokens components, metering ingestion lag, pricing table version
5) “Guardrails / Canary” (per region)
   - benchmark job limits, production SLO canary, auto-stop triggers

Reviewer notes / gaps
- We are missing a clean “Region Health” screenshot for ap-southeast-1 embeddings warmup in window B (should be captured next refresh).
- For the report PDF appendix we only need the end-of-run summary per region + 1 metering sanity screenshot (global) per run window.

Retention & access
- Drive links are internal-only (Redwood). For external proof points, we should only embed cropped charts/screenshots in the report; do not share dashboard URLs.
- Artifact bucket is internal-only and immutable for 180 days. If we need longer retention for future refresh comparisons, file ENG task to extend retention for the benchmark prefix.

Owner checklist (for next benchmark refresh)
- [ ] Create new Drive folder: RI-bm-YYYY-MM-DD-windowX
- [ ] Capture warmup/midrun/endrun for each region in scope
- [ ] Capture global metering sanity at midrun + endrun
- [ ] If anomaly occurs, capture “anomaly” screenshot before rerun + note reason
- [ ] Paste links into this index + update missing items section
